title: Standardized Cycle-Data Audit Schema & Descriptive H1 Criteria

contraction_factor_definitions.rho_d: delta_d_Linf^(k) / delta_d_Linf^(k-1) (computed only when denominator >= 1e-12, else null)
contraction_factor_definitions.missing_value_policy: explicitly null; zero is never fabricated for non-calculable ratios

descriptive_h1_criteria.sustained_contraction_supported: Both update magnitudes decrease across the final five available cycles, with geometric-mean contraction factors below 0.95.
descriptive_h1_criteria.loss_of_contraction_detected: Both factors exceed 1.0 across at least three consecutive cycles.
descriptive_h1_criteria.inconclusive: Any other pattern or insufficient telemetry.

scientific_interpretation_correction.principle: These criteria classify observed iteration behavior, not mathematical existence or nonexistence of equilibrium.
scientific_interpretation_correction.package120_clarification: Three consecutive expansion factors demonstrate loss of contraction over those cycles, but do not mathematically prove that no stationary equilibrium exists or that additional iterations could never converge.

h2_hypothesis_formulation.statement: At authentic Increment 88, the C3 same-mesh AM-PDAS control achieves stationary equilibrium within the original 15-cycle budget, whereas the refined C4 control did not.

decision_rules.if_h2_passes: Nonstationarity is associated with the refined receiver formulation/state or its transfer preparation, but the exact cause remains unresolved.
decision_rules.if_h2_fails: The nonstationarity problem also affects same-mesh re-equilibration at advanced damage. Source-state consistency must be investigated before claiming physical instability.
